none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: The quasar condition permits nonconvex objectives; convexity is not required.

problem_class.label: quasar
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable τ-quasar-convex minimization: a global minimizer xstar satisfies τ(f(x)−f(xstar)) ≤ ⟨∇f(x),x−xstar⟩ for every x, with 0<τ≤1 and ‖x0−xstar‖≤R.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: Each query x returns the exact value f(x), together with an inexact gradient, in one oracle call.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/QuasarSignedBias.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible oracle-answer clause; LongTails/Template.lean: execute.

oracle.label: inexact_gradient
oracle.details: Call k returns ∇f(x)+b(k+1)−b(k). The hidden sequence b is independent of the query and oracle seed, with b(0)=0 and ‖b(k)‖≤B.

distinctive_assumptions.label: biased_oracle
distinctive_assumptions.details: The additive gradient errors are deterministic and need not be unbiased, vanish, or satisfy a pointwise relative-error bound. B≥0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: temporal_discrepancy
distinctive_assumptions.details: Errors e_k=b(k+1)−b(k) telescope: ‖Σ_{k=0}^{n−1}e_k‖≤B for every n, and ‖Σ_{k=m}^{n−1}e_k‖≤2B. Errors may persist and cancel across calls; no independence or mixing assumption is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is an arbitrary real Hilbert space. Gradients exist everywhere and satisfy ‖∇f(x)‖≤M, with M>0; Lipschitz continuity of the gradient is not assumed. E, M, B, R≥0, τ, ε>0, and x0 are public, while f, b, and the minimizer are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/QuasarSignedBias.lean: Params; spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Output one point in E satisfying f(output)−f(xstar)≤ε for a global minimizer xstar; no prescribed iterate or averaging requirement.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, within the fixed budget max{1,⌈R²(M²+2MB)/(τ²ε²)⌉} oracle calls.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/QuasarSignedBias.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence; supplied OracleTemplate.QuasarSignedBias.result budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Quasar-convex minimization is combined with an unusual deterministic, query-independent telescoping gradient-error model with uniformly bounded cumulative discrepancy, exact function values, and an almost-sure guarantee in an arbitrary real Hilbert space.
